_comment: Steps GitHub runs on Disaster-Recovery PRs that cannot be reproduced on a laptop by the pr-release-gate CI mirror. Every entry says why. GitHub still runs every one of these on the PR, and the PR stays draft until those checks are green. Written 30/09/2026 from the ci-mirror report for c239675e; every ci.yml and pre-build-check.yml step ran and passed locally.

exempt.reason: actions/github-script merging an open PR through GITHUB_TOKEN; there is no PR before push, and it only acts on PRs carrying the auto-merge label.

Third-party action. Substitute run locally: gitleaks 8.30.1 `gitleaks git --log-opts=<base>..<head>` over the branch commits, with a positive control (planted ghp_ token in a scratch repo reported 1 leak).
Third-party action (treosh/lighthouse-ci-action) auditing deployed URLs; needs the live site or a preview deployment, which does not exist before push.
Calls the metered Anthropic API with secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the repository secret is not available locally and must not be copied here.
Creates a Vercel preview deployment with secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN / VERCEL_ORG_ID; a deployment is an outbound action that only GitHub performs.
Smoke-tests the preview URL produced by deploy-preview, which does not exist before push.
